sections.title: Reign of Talon: Season 3 - Into The Tiger's Den
sections.description: Reign of Talon - Season 3: Into the Tiger's Den takes Overwatch to a place where bright lights cut through the shadow and who you stand with matters most. Shion arrives as a fast and deadly new Damage Hero leading the notorious Hashimoto Clan, testing your resolve at every turn. Plus, explore the first new Hybrid map in the Anima Strike Meta Event, uncovering secrets and earning rewards by playing your way through the story. Then blaze into battle as Mythic Ascendant Phoenix Illari, wield Hanzo’s Tokyo Rebel Mythic weapon, and suit up in a brand-new Ultra Skin cosmetic tier to bring more spectacle and style to your fight for a better future.

blocks.title: New Hero: Shion
blocks.body: Shion arrives as a flashy and unhinged new Omnic Damage Hero, leader of the notorious Hashimoto Clan in Tokyo. Once held captive, isolated, and controlled by those who feared her, she now lords over it all with terrifying confidence and a taste for excess. Shion's kit is built around her aggressive movement, relentless pressure, and overflowing style, to take your enemies for a wild ride. Dual semi-auto pistols, omnidirectional dashes, and a motorcycle you can throw will make the streets run red when you're through.

blocks.title: New Map: Neon Junction
blocks.body: Hybrid play has a new battleground, set beneath glowing storefronts on the streets of Tokyo. Fight through the nightlife to capture the Neon Junction, making sure to stop and explore - you never know what treasures you may find! Then escort the one and only ANDROMEDA III payload toward Zuiko-za, where the city’s polished surface starts to crack. Every section of the map comes alive with detail, from giant towering robots to shady alleyways that hint at who really controls the streets after dark.

blocks.title: Anima Strike
blocks.body: A shadow looms over Tokyo... With support from Overwatch, Kiriko and her companions - the Yōkai - fight to loosen the grip of the Hashimoto criminal organization over the city. To do so, they must face off against the Hashimoto's vicious leader, Shion. Over the course of three weeks from June 16th - July 6th, players will battle their way through different locations in Tokyo by completing challenges. Each week features a unique 2D hub layout themed around a different location: Neon Junction Yōkai Hideout Hashimoto Headquarters Each layout has branching paths, narrative unlocks, and new rewards - available for only that week. There's also a new Prestige track to tackle each week for the most dedicated players. After completing the Prestige track, players unlock the ability to complete the path(s) they didn't choose for that week's layout; however, once the week resets and a new week begins during the event, a new map with new rewards becomes available, and the previous week's layout becomes inaccessible. In total, players can earn: 18 Lootboxes 3 Epic Lootboxes 3 Legendary Lootboxes 3 Voice Lines 1 Victory Pose (from Milestone challenge) 3 Sprays 4 Namecards 90k BP XP 5 Titles (3 from Milestone challenges) 4 Avatars 2 Charms 1 Souvenir

blocks.title: Community Crafted
blocks.body: What if Ana had a jetpack? What if Junker Queen could throw her axe? What if Widowmaker could place an explosive tripwire? Well wonder no more, because we've worked with four of your favorite creators – Guxue, Apply, Ocie, and mL7support – to change every single hero based on their ideas! From June 30 until July 13, play this brand new version of Overwatch in the Arcade and earn the following rewards: Zenyatta Pachi Icon Reinhardt Spray Sombra Pachi Icon Hanzo Pachi Icon Genji Feather Weapon Charm Cassidy BAMF Weapon Charm "Doomscroller" Rare Title

blocks.title: Excavation Initiative
blocks.body: It’s time to break out the excavator and find some treasure! Join us for this new season-long event from June 16 to August 10th, unlocking lootboxes along the way! Win one game per day, on any 3 days during the week to complete a dig and earn a lootbox. Dedicated players can complete two digs a week to earn an additional lootbox. Complete a dig twice during the season to gain access to an additional lootbox. Complete a dig 4 times during the season for an epic lootbox. Our most dedicated archaeologists can complete 6 digs during the season to unlock a legendary lootbox Track daily/weekly progress directly from the lobby View your season progress from the event hub

blocks.title: Junkrat's Loot Hunt
blocks.body: Junkrat's Loot Hunt is back again, running from July 10 - July 14! Earn lootboxes by completing challenges that unlock as you play!

sections.title: General Updates
sections.description: Our Nintendo Switch™ client will be receiving a rebase, which will result in longer download times for users on that platform. Continued to expand our Advanced Info Panel keywords for some of the more opaque ability interactions with: Crush, Heal Amp Cap, Ignore Energy, Reduction Cap and Strong Reduction - Read them to find out more!

blocks.title: Sound
blocks.body: Added a new Option under Sound → General → Sounds to control the volume of Teammate/Enemy Eliminated Sound Effects.

blocks.title: Controls
blocks.body: Removed the default keybind for Toggle UI (previously ALT+Z). Players who wish to use this feature can reassign it manually under Options > Controls.

blocks.title: Accessibility
blocks.body: Added two new Options under Accessibility → General → Chat. High Contrast Chat lets players have a dark background that makes chat easier to read. Chat Background Opacity lets players control how dark the background is if High Contrast Chat is disabled.

blocks.title: Social
blocks.body: In a previous update, added a Favorites category to the Friend Panel to help players quickly find favorited friends.

blocks.title: Hero Bans
blocks.body: The Roster (described in more detail in Core Game Updates below) gives players the ability to share their favorite heroes with their teams to enable better coordination. A player's Preferred Hero (their #1 hero in the Roster by default) now contributes 3 negative votes during Hero Bans. This would nullify one player's 3rd place vote. Lobby Bans are a 5th ban slot that can break the 2 hero Role Limit. Unlike all other hero bans, Lobby Bans are calculated by adding together all votes from both teams. If both teams had at least 1 vote for a hero and there were 10 total votes for a hero (such as one first place and one third place vote), the hero will be Lobby Banned. The Ban Results page of Hero Bans has new visual updates to help players understand the snake draft and to display the Lobby Ban. The Hero Bans phase now displays the number of votes for each of your choices (7 for 1st place, 5 for 2nd place, and 3 for 3rd place) and the total number of votes your team has contributed together for each hero.
blocks.dev: The Roster was built with Competitive Play in mind, allowing players to communicate their preferred heroes effortlessly, but it's also useful to Quick Play players that want to pick the best map for their allies. Negative votes for preferred heroes prevent most cases where one teammate could successfully vote to ban your preferred hero alone, assuming you also vote to ban at least two other heroes. If two players on your team want to ban your preferred hero they'll still be able to out-vote you though. Lobby Bans are designed to ensure that Hero Bans feel more responsive to player preferences, banning heroes that both teams prefer not to play against. Lobby Bans also give players a better reason than ever to vote if they want a specific hero banned.

blocks.title: Top 500 Challenger Live Replays
blocks.body: All players can now watch live replays of ongoing matches for players on the Top 500 Challenger Leaderboards. Live Replays are streamed to viewers with a delay to prevent the feature from being used for a competitive advantage by other players. Live replays share controls with the existing replay function. For players on any leaderboard, this feature can be disabled in the Options under Social → Privacy → Leaderboards. The setting is called "Hide Leaderboard Live Replay" and is defaulted to Off.

blocks.title: Cheater Compensation
blocks.body: Rank Progress compensation awarded to higher Rank players no scales down by respecting the Pressure Modifier.

sections.title: Hero Updates
sections.description: The perk system has continued to evolve since Season 1, with ongoing additions to heroes and perks across the roster. This patch includes targeted adjustments to perks that are out of line in pick rate, win rate, or overall effectiveness, with the goal of improving viability and maintaining meaningful choice.

blocks.title: The Roster
blocks.body: Players can now choose their Top 3 preferred heroes in each Role to be displayed to their team during all Pregame phases (Map Voting, Preferred Hero, Hero Bans). Players can change which heroes appear in the Roster from the Main Menu, while they're in queue, and during Pregame phases (changes made in the Pregame are not saved, since they'd often be in response to a map or allied hero choice). Players can opt into only displaying 2, 1, or 0 heroes (no preference), but by default the 3 displayed heroes will be the same heroes used on the Player Cards. Players can see their group members' Roster of heroes by opening the social context menu that offers other social options like Whisper and View Career Profile.

blocks.title: Map Voting Updates
blocks.body: The maps on offer should be much less likely to be maps you played within the last 5 matches. This change will help players that play for shorter sessions to be much more likely to experience more map variety.

blocks.title: Practice Range
blocks.body: Floating Combat Text has been enabled for the Core Game's Practice Range.

blocks.title: Post-Match Accolades
blocks.body: Retuned many cards that showed up too often (looking at you Echo Sticky Bombs) and increased the odds of some cards appearing.

blocks.title: Streamer Mode

blocks.title: General Changes
blocks.body: Grouping Restrictions have been removed from Stadium Ranked.
blocks.dev: Due to the progressive nature of Stadium Ranked, grouping restrictions felt ineffective and often prevented players from playing with their friends while still allowing players to queue into other players with wide Stadium Rank disparities if their hidden MMRs were close enough.

blocks.title: General
blocks.body: Fixed an issue where the Sierra World Cup skin would not appear correctly. Fixed an issue causing Ashe to receive more damage than intended when hit by her own Dynamite. Fixed an issue causing the UI indicator for Brigitte's Inspire to not account for the Morale Boost perk. Fixed an issue where the audio cues from Lucio's perks would unintentionally give his location away. Fixed an issue where Orisa would still be pinned even if Fortify was activated at the exact same time she was hit by Reinhardt’s Charge. Fixed an issue where the Survivor sub‑role’s passive healing would incorrectly trigger if a movement ability was used before taking damage. Fixed an issue where the extra fuel from Pharah’s Fuel Store perk would not activate if her fuel was decaying prior to using Jet Dash. Fixed an issue where Sierra could unintentionally grapple to her drone when it went out of sight. Fixed an issue where Sierra could not destroy her drone while dead. Fixed an issue where Sierra's Tremor Charges were not amplified by Amplification Matrix. Fixed an issue where Mercy’s Guardian Angel UI button would appear to activate without a valid target. Fixed an issue where the Toggle Beam Setting for Mercy could cause inconsistent behavior when switching between beam types. Fixed an issue where Sierra's Anchor Drone would block certain abilities like Reinhardt Charge. Fixed an issue where Cassidy's Deadeye UI would not update correctly against Vendetta when she used her Warding Stance. Fixed an issue where some Knockdown abilities did not affect d.va's mech during Self-Destruct. Fixed an issue where heroes with the Recon subrole passive could sometimes ping Sombra while she was invisible. Fixed an issue where Athena's VO would incorrectly say that the lead had been lost in Push when teams were tied for total distance. Fixed several text bugs in Post Match Accolades with card text (Hyper Rings, Power Slides, etc...). Fixed several text bugs in the Advanced Info Panel. In a previous update, fixed a bug where Ramattra could bypass Void Barrier's cooldown.

blocks.title: Stadium
blocks.body: Fixed an issue where Lifesteal was incorrectly granting currency despite being Restore and not Healing. Fixed an issue where Juno's Fission Chamber did not scale properly with Attack Speed. Fixed an issue where Juno's Blink Boosts allowed her to use Glide Boost while crowd controlled. Fixed an issue where Juno's Blink Boosts prevented Glide Boost from scaling properly with Cooldown Reduction. Fixed an issue where Juno's Boosted Rockets granted more Glide Boost duration than intended when combined with Blink Boosts. Fixed an issue where Ana's IV Drip didn't have reduced overhealth when combined with Fountain of Soothe. Fixed an issue where Brigitte's Optimizer was granting more self healing than expected. Fixed an issue where Zenyatta's Enlightenment was incorrectly healing over 1 and not granting ultimate charge or currency Fixed an issue where Ana's Venomous was not dealing reduced damage when spawned with Fountain of Soothe. Fixed an issue where Martian Mender was healing less than intended on DVa. Fixed an issue where Doomfist's Aftershock power would always hit targets hit the first time Fixed an issue where Liquid Nitrogen was overwriting slows instead of adding to them. Fixed an issue where Vendetta's Cataclisma Power would not trigger if the initial hit kills the enemy.
